Paragraph: "A friend is the resultant factor of helpfulness... that I know... oh, great monkey I intend eliminate that Vali, the abductor of your wife...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Making a solemn commitment to eliminate the source of Sugreeva's trauma.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama defines true friendship as mutual helpfulness and vows to kill Vali.
Outcome/Resolution: Provides absolute assurance of protection and justice.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Providing definitive resolution and promise of safety

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Mitra-dharma (the sacred duty of a friend to protect and deliver justice)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Rama establishes the core ethic of friendship: active intervention to remove injustice.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Offering a concrete, actionable guarantee of resolution to eliminate a major stressor.
